fields.note: Section 4(a)-(e) lists the prohibited conduct. Section 3 defines coordinating function. Section 5 preserves the Antitrust Act remedies. Section 7 requires the complaint location, section 8 allows rulemaking, and section 6(b) bars conflicting municipal ordinances. The rule's wording is a condensed paraphrase.
